description: This Java source file defines a custom ListView subclass called InsertionListView that handles dynamic row addition with animation effects, specifically for a list of ListItemObject items in an Android application. It manages animations for inserting new rows and associated image pop-ins, including handling of view positions, drawables, and animation sequences.

classes.name: InsertionListView
classes.description: A custom ListView subclass implementing animated insertion of new rows and images, managing animation sequences and view position tracking.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new ListItemObject to the top of the list and animates the insertion along with associated visual effects.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the underlying data list controlling the list adapter.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets the parent RelativeLayout for overlaying animation views.

methods.name: setRowAdditionAnimationListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to respond to the start and end of row addition animations.

methods.name: shouldAnimateInNewRow
methods.description: Determines if the new row should animate based on list scroll position.

methods.name: shouldAnimateInNewImage
methods.description: Determines if the image associated with the new row should animate in.

methods.name: getBitmapDrawableFromView
methods.description: Creates a BitmapDrawable snapshot of a given view, used for animation overlays.

methods.name: getLocationOnScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the absolute screen coordinates of a view.
